video.title: AI欧腐《外星Alpha的宿命伴侣/The Alien Alpha's Fated Mate》
video.desc:
Earth's fiercest commander wakes from death to find an alien Alpha kissing him awake. The sheltered ruler knows nothing of human hearts—no smiles, no tears, no words for want—yet he bonds his soul to the stranger he saved. When the commander discovers his gentle mate lied to keep him safe, the war for Earth becomes a lesson in trust, sacrifice, and the fate that binds them across the stars.
地球最骁勇的指挥官从死亡中苏醒，睁眼便看见一个外星 Alpha 正吻醒自己。这位深居简出的异星统治者，对人类的情感一无所知——不会笑，不会哭，连"渴望"这个词都没有——却将灵魂与自己救下的这个陌生人缔结为一体。当指挥官发现，温柔的伴侣为了保护他而撒了谎，这场地球保卫战，便成了一堂关于信任、牺牲，以及那份跨越星海将他们相连的宿命的课。
